 Oral Judgment
(Per: The Hon'Ble Dr. Justice Chillakur Sumalatha)
The appeal was filed in the month of February 2025 and till now, office objections are not complied.
This Court does not find any grounds to grant further time.
Therefore, the appeal stands dismissed for non-compliance of office objections.
